2023.note: Six allied-party counts are supported by original 2023 reports: RCCK 41, Democratic League 56, CAPD 54, Peasants’ and Workers’ 60, Jiusan 56 and TDSGL 14. The Peasants’ and Workers’ source is a contemporary republication of the party’s membership announcement. Communist Party, CNDCA and Zhi Gong counts are unknown and shown as dashes; their deputies are included in the grey remainder, which also includes unaffiliated deputies. Later party membership lists are not substituted for initial composition: Jiusan later lists 61 and TDSGL later 13. Party membership can change or overlap; the diagram records these reported categories and does not claim a verified individual-by-individual party census.

1975.note: The historical table reports 2,217 Communist Party members alongside 76.3%, figures that do not agree against 2,885 deputies. Our count is left unknown rather than choosing one of these conflicting figures. All deputies remain in the unresolved membership category pending a reconciled original source.
